attributes.honesty: Keeping promises or telling difficult truths; routine speech earns nothing.
attributes.compassion: Listening to another person's needs without deciding for them.
attributes.curiosity: A meaningful experiment or discovery; routine walking or questions earn nothing.
attributes.mischief: Inventive playful disruption; not inherently bad.
attributes.generosity: Giving something wanted without making it a debt.

archive_open.instruction: Only after the player unlocks the collection room with Marta’s loaned key. Do not require any performance or secret password.

soundwalk_shared.instruction: Only after the player chooses to play both local recordings back with Samir. This is a modest optional listening project; it never ends the afternoon.

water_recorded.instruction: Only after deliberately recording the sound of the water. Merely carrying a recorder here is not recording.

square_recorded.instruction: Only after deliberately recording ambient square sounds. Do not secretly record private conversations; choose a fountain or footsteps instead.

booth_open.instruction: Only after the player uses Ada’s loaned key on the projection cupboard door.

projector_ready.instruction: Only after the player fits the checked adapter into the labelled low-voltage projector socket and switches it on. Update the projection cupboard description. No work on mains wiring is involved.

film_shared.instruction: Only after the player chooses to watch Ada’s offered fifteen-second trolley-wheel film in the screening room. It is an optional shared moment, not a reason to finish the adventure.

achievements.text: Two ordinary places have become a small piece of listening. You can keep exploring, or simply hear it again.
The little film has had its little audience. There is still an afternoon around it.

schedules.fact: Piero has taken a break on the bench by the piazza fountain.
schedules.hears: You have taken a short break by the piazza fountain. You may idly invent a new destination for a bus, or sit without explaining yourself. If a visitor is present, you may talk; do not demand attention.

schedules.fact: Ada has taken two spare chairs out to the circolo forecourt.
schedules.hears: You have taken two spare chairs outside for a break. Watch the shape of the afternoon shadow or sit. If someone is here, ordinary company is welcome; no screening announcement or request for work is needed.

bus_departure.instruction: Only if the player explicitly boards a departing bus to leave Valdilume for good. Checking the timetable, waiting or walking here does not end play.
bus_departure.text: You take a seat on the valley bus. Valdilume folds behind the bend as the foothills widen beyond the window.

enough_for_today.instruction: Only if the player explicitly wants to end the adventure. Resting, waiting, silence or taking a nap is not quitting.
enough_for_today.text: You close the afternoon at a moment of your choosing. Valdilume carries on around you.

evening_rest.instruction: Only if the player explicitly chooses to call the adventure finished here and leave the rest of the evening unplayed. Sitting, watching the sky or resting alone is not enough.
evening_rest.text: You let the evening remain unplanned. A little sky above the hedge is enough for the last moment of your visit.
